method: USGS TNM Access API, Historical Topographic Maps dataset; original GeoTIFF retained as provider-supplied native raster.

dateEvidence.note: The API publicationDate is retained as the publication year. For every bundled product the title ends in a single edition year; this merged shard has no mismatch between that printed year and publicationDate (and neither did this slice on its own). No depicted/survey date is inferred.

selection.rightsBasis: USGS official statement "USGS-authored or produced data and information are considered to be in the U.S. Public Domain" (copyrights-and-credits page), applicable to USGS-produced HTMC products; each record carries the policy URL and USGS attribution.
selection.rule: Every admitted product is returned by the TNM Access API under datasets=Historical Topographic Maps, carries a ScienceBase item URL and a delivered original GeoTIFF download. Undated products and products without a preview stay eligible; products without a GeoTIFF are withheld. The bbox is the product footprint, not an image transform.

resumable.note: Re-run with --start-offset <nextOffset> to continue the feed. Existing ids are preserved and merged, never replaced by a smaller page.
